dict.string: Disko measures the size of files on your Desktop. It never opens or changes them.
Disko measures the size of files in Documents. It never opens or changes them.
Disko measures the size of files in Downloads. It never opens or changes them.
Disko only measures external drives if you choose one explicitly.
Disko only measures network drives if you choose one explicitly.
Disko skips iCloud Drive and other cloud folders; it only needs to see that they exist.
